purpose: Create or verify exactly one realistic Universaarl payment term NET30 on the Business Central Payment Terms page with before/after/reopen evidence.
businessPurpose: Universaarl needs one simple B2B customer payment term before the first customer setup write gate. This case creates the setup prerequisite only; it does not write the customer card or prove invoice due dates.

smartDecision.whyNow: The customer setup value decision is blocked by an empty Payment Terms page. One payment term is the smallest useful setup prerequisite before writing U-CUST-100 payment terms.
sourceBasis: Microsoft Learn confirms payment terms manage due dates and discounts.
Universaarl evidence shows the Payment Terms page is reachable with the direct Page 4 route plus profile=Business Manager.
The successful write gate shows NET30 / 30 Tage netto / 30T after reopen proof and shows the partial bad row from the earlier attempt was deleted.
U-CUST-100 currently has an empty Payment Terms Code.
fieldsChangedOnlyIfSafe: Calc. Pmt. Disc. on Cr. Memos false
smartDecision.fallback: If NET30 later disappears or conflicts, stop with screenshots and keep CUSTOMER-SETUP-VALUE-WRITE-GATE parked.

acceptanceCriteria: Business Central shell proves playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Before screenshot proves Payment Terms page context.
NET30 is visible after save or already existed with matching values.
Reopen proof shows NET30 and the due-date formula 30T.
No customer, document, Preview Posting, Posting, payment or API shortcut occurs.
Result JSON states what is proven and not proven.
stopIf: Payment Terms page cannot be proven by screenshot/text/Page Inspection.
The UI demands a broad import, wizard, delete or unrelated confirmation.
The due-date formula route is unclear after screenshot/tooltip/context inspection.
Any customer card or document would need to be opened to complete this case.
